_note: Written for products whose original description described a different product entirely (a spark machine sold as a flower wall, etc). Each line is grounded in the product's own photograph and media-library title.
2-hearts: Two red heart arches, eight foot and six and a half, set side by side so the moment has depth as well as height.
3-hearts-set: Three red heart arches — one eight foot centrepiece flanked by a pair at six and a half. Our most photographed setup.
set-of-3-hearts: An eight foot heart arch between two smaller hearts, layered to frame you from every angle the camera finds.
3-panels-w-arch: Three sculpted panels finished with floral accents and crowned by an arch, for a proposal that reads as an installation.
3d-layered-w-arch: Layered three-dimensional panelling, an additional flower archway and your own custom sign, built as one composition.
3d-panel-w-arch: Dimensional panelling paired with a floral archway — architectural, quiet, and impossible to walk past.
arch-w-gate: A floral archway set behind an ornamental gate, so the walk toward the question is part of the design.
artica: A white half archway in soft florals. Understated, luminous, and flattering in low winter light.
avirl: Archway and backdrop together, layered so the florals carry all the way to the frame's edge.
c: A green and white archway with an open, sculptural sweep and foliage worked through in generous drifts.
cloud-9: A cream heart arch in dense blooms — the softest, most forgiving light of anything we build.
cloud-9-2: A half circle arch in white, cut clean against the skyline and lit to hold its shape after dark.
cloud-9-3: Cream blooms drawn into a full heart, warm rather than white, and gentle on camera.
cupid: A red half circle arch, saturated and unmissable, for a proposal that does not intend to whisper.
cupid-2: A full red heart arch in deep roses — the classic, executed properly.
cupid-squared: Red florals on a squared archway, the romance of the colour with an architectural edge.
eve: A green and white arch, garden-fresh and generous, at home in a park or on a rooftop.
gladys: An elegant floral archway in muted tones, styled for couples who want the flowers to flatter rather than shout.
halo: A white circle arch finished with a Marry Me sign at its centre — the question, framed literally.
heavenly: A white flower arch, bright and uncomplicated, that photographs cleanly against almost any backdrop.
heavenly-2: A green archway heavy with foliage, cool and calm, beautiful under an overcast sky.
heavenly-3: Whites and creams drawn into a full arch — simple, and all the better for it.
infinity: A squared green and white archway, geometric and modern, softened entirely by the planting.
infinity-2: A full red circle arch. Round, saturated, and striking from any distance.
infinity-3: Green and white circular archways layered against a matching backdrop for real depth of field.
infinity-4: A white heart archway, weightless-looking and quietly romantic.
infinity-5: A red circle arch with a Marry Me sign set inside it, so the photograph tells the whole story on its own.
isis: A pink heart arch in blush and rose, romantic without tipping into sweet.
joy: A green arch, lush and unfussy, that lets the two of you stay the subject.
joy-3: A white floral archway threaded with baby's breath — delicate, and lovely in evening light.
lotus-flower: A deep green archway with real weight to the foliage, cool-toned and calm.
lotus-flower-2: Pink and cream blooms across a clean arch, warm and soft-focus by nature.
marie: A cream flower arch in dense, tonal blooms. Timeless, and the safest beautiful choice we offer.
marie-2: Cream florals worked into a full arch — warm, classic, and never dated.
miamor: A red half archway, bold and close, built to fill the frame of a single photograph.
monterey: A green and white half arch, fresh and airy, that suits daylight and open spaces.
monterey-2: A half archway in soft greens and whites, styled for an unhurried, natural look.
mrs-gladys: A cream flower arch with a gentle sweep, generous with the blooms and kind to every skin tone.
rosie: An oval arch — the softer, more forgiving shape, and our most flattering frame for two people.
snow-flake: A green archway with crisp white accents, cool and clean and lovely against stone or glass.
snowflake: A white circle arch, pure and graphic, that reads beautifully in a wide shot.
snowflake-2: A white circle arch finished with a Marry Me sign, ready for the photograph you will actually frame.
artica-2: A white half floral archway, luminous and restrained, styled for an intimate proposal.
avirl-2: Archway and backdrop layered together so the florals fill the whole frame.
cupid-squared-2: A squared red archway in deep roses — architectural lines, unmistakably romantic colour.
gladys-2: A softly toned floral archway, elegant and unshowy, designed to flatter the couple first.
cloud-9-4: Cream blooms in a full heart, warm rather than stark.
custom-packages: Nothing here quite right? Tell us the moment you have in mind and we will build it from scratch.
custom-packages-2: Bring us the idea, the location and the date, and we will design the installation around it.
flower-wall-w-arch: A flower wall and archway combined into a single set piece, for proposals that want scale.
2-half-rounded-panels: Two half-rounded panels, set as a pair to give a proposal real architecture behind it.
2-rectangular-panels: Two clean rectangular panels — the most modern, least fussy backdrop we build.
2-round-panels: A pair of rounded panels, soft-edged and sculptural, that photograph well from a distance.
black-berry-frame-set-of-2: Two deep berry-toned frames, dramatic against evening light and rich on camera.
black-berry-frame-set-of-3: Three berry-toned frames in sequence, layered for depth and a genuinely cinematic backdrop.
flower-wall-and-2-panels: A full flower wall flanked by two panels, widening the set so a group can stand in it.
flower-wall-and-gold-green: A flower wall in greenery and gold — warm metal against fresh foliage, luxurious without gloss.
flower-wall-and-golden-gates: A flower wall set behind golden gates, so the approach is as considered as the arrival.
golden-frame-set-of-3: Three golden frames staged in sequence, catching light from every direction.
golden-gate-frame-set-of-2: Two golden gate frames, formal and symmetrical, for a proposal with real occasion to it.
golden-rounded-gate: A rounded golden gate, softer than the square, and beautiful lit from below after dark.
golden-square-gates: Squared golden gates with clean lines and a lot of presence in a wide photograph.
half-rounded-panel-set: Three half-rounded panels as a set, curved to wrap gently around the couple.
rainbow: A layered three-dimensional panel backdrop with real depth in the shadow lines.
rainbow-gold: Layered dimensional panelling with an additional panel and your own custom sign, finished in gold.
rainbow-platinum: Our fullest layered set — dimensional panels, an additional flower archway and a custom sign together.
round-panel-set: Three rounded panels arranged as one continuous curve.
rounded-3d: A rounded dimensional panel backdrop, sculptural and quietly modern.
rounded-platinum-plus: Three panels finished with floral accents, our most complete rounded set.
set-of-3-rectangular-panels: Three rectangular panels in a row — clean, generous, and easy to light.
white-and-gold-panel-w-flower-panel: A white and gold panel paired with a full flower panel, warm metal against fresh blooms.
white-gold-panel-w-greenery: A white and gold panel dressed with greenery, crisp and fresh and never heavy.
candles: Candlelight along the approach and around the setup. The single cheapest thing that changes how a proposal feels.
cold-spark-fountains: Cold spark fountains on cue as she says yes — all the drama of pyrotechnics, safe indoors.
cold-spark-fountains-2: Sparks that rise on cue at the moment of the yes. Safe for indoor venues.
cold-sparks: A curtain of cold sparks timed to the moment. Bright, brief, and unforgettable on video.
confetti-machine: Confetti on cue the second she says yes, so the celebration starts inside the same photograph.
floral-accents: Extra florals worked through the setup, filling gaps and softening every edge.
floral-runners: Floral runners along the walkway, turning the approach into part of the proposal.
fog-machine: A low layer of fog across the floor, so the setup appears to sit on cloud.
marry-me-marquee-letters: Illuminated MARRY ME letters, tall enough to read across a rooftop and bright enough to shoot at night.
red-carpets: A red carpet from the door to the arch. Simple, theatrical, and it makes the walk feel deliberate.
rose-petals: Rose petals scattered through the setup and along the path in.
uplighting: Uplighting in your colour, washing the installation and holding it beautifully after dark.
will-you-marry-me-neon-sign: A Will You Marry Me neon, warm and glowing, that carries the whole photograph on its own.
mourning-cloak: A rose gold flower wall with real warmth to it — metallic without ever looking hard.
palm: A deep green wall of foliage, cool and lush, and a beautiful contrast to a city backdrop.
pink-and-purple-ombre: Pink fading into purple across the full wall, graduated so the colour moves as you move.
milan-rose: A wall of red roses, dense and saturated, for the most classically romantic setting we offer.
ruby-red: Red and white blooms worked together across the wall — bold, with the white keeping it light.
valinda-rose: A long red luxury flower wall, our widest single backdrop, built for larger gatherings.
valindas-garden: Multi-tonal roses across the full wall, layered so no two photographs look quite the same.
neon-signs: Custom neon in your own words, bent to order and lit warm. The detail guests photograph first.
miamor-2: A red half archway, close and bold, built to fill a single frame completely.
rosie-2: An oval arch — the softest shape we build, and the kindest to a photograph of two people.
abigail: A wall of deep crimson — roses, burgundy foliage and dark red ferns packed edge to edge. The richest, most saturated backdrop we build.
monarch: An English-garden wall: dense green foliage with roses scattered through it in magenta, blush, cream and deep red. Reads as grown rather than built.
pink-and-blue: Pastel blue and pink roses marbled through one another across the full wall. The obvious choice for a gender reveal, and lovely for a spring proposal.
pink-butterfly-arch: A boxwood green wall crowned with an arch of white and blush roses — fresh, garden-like, and flattering in daylight.
pink-butterfly: Blush, cream and white roses packed dense with fine greenery and gypsophila threaded through. Soft, romantic and very forgiving on camera.
